about.bio:
Robert Baskin is a writer and Ph.D. candidate in the English department at Boston College, where he studies Weird fiction, modernism, and philosophical aesthetics. His dissertation compares modernism and Weird fiction's responses to various crises in the late 19th and early 20th century.

His writing has appeared in academic journals and magazines. When not reading, writing or researching, he can be found making music, watching movies, walking around cities, and trying to understand weight lifting. He is always happy to talk with students, journalists, critics, and fellow readers, and can be reached at the email below.
